key_insight: FICE is the first fully inductive learned cardinality estimator for SPARQL Basic Graph Patterns, able to generalize to unseen graphs and relations without retraining.
engineering_relevance: It targets real triplestore deployment by combining sub-millisecond latency with improved cardinality estimates for query optimization.
method: Encoder GNN builds entity and relation embeddings on a factor-graph view of the KG.
A decoder GNN composes these embeddings along the query join structure to predict log-cardinality.
Joint training and neighborhood sampling make the model scalable to millions of triples.
evidence_signal: Across 10 knowledge graphs, FICE cuts median q-error to 5.34 versus 13.54 for the best competitor and shows stronger tail performance.
watch_item: Performance depends on accurate neighborhood-based message passing, so scalability and quality may be sensitive to graph structure and sampling choices.
